blind.sample_role: Analytic allele/chromosome counts in the 2 × 2 association contingency table: 106 affected alleles and 102 control alleles. The corresponding contributor count is 104 participants (53 affected, 51 controls), not 208 participants.
blind.exclusions: Rare alleles, persistent partial digests, and otherwise unscorable alleles excluded (p. 214). Table 1 final counts used, not the recruitment total of 55 affected and 51 controls. ApaLI Table 2 final genotypes total 53 affected and 51 controls; two affected participants lack usable ApaLI genotype information; specific reasons for those two are not individually stated.

disposition.reason: Table 1 explicitly labels affected and control allele counts for the target ApaLI test. Sum final mutually exclusive allele cells; keep allele observations separate from participant contributors.

disposition.calculation: (41 + 65) + (56 + 46) = 106 + 102 = 208 analytic alleles/chromosomes. Separate contributor count from Table 2: (6 + 29 + 18) + (16 + 24 + 11) = 53 + 51 = 104 participants. Excluded unusable alleles per p. 214; 2 of 55 affected contributors absent from final ApaLI genotype counts; controls 51 retained.

worker_target_description: PBGD ApaLI D1/D2 allele-frequency association between affected schizophrenia/schizoaffective subjects and normal controls, p. 213 Table 1; chi-square with one degree of freedom.
worker_notes: Only assigned unfinished fields assessed; unassigned fields are placeholders. Analytic N arithmetic: affected alleles 41 + 65 = 106; control alleles 56 + 46 = 102; mutually exclusive disease groups and allele categories sum to 208 alleles. Separately, Table 2 mutually exclusive genotypes give affected participants 6 + 29 + 18 = 53 and controls 16 + 24 + 11 = 51, total 104 participants; this is contributor N, not the allele-count unit of Table 1. No division by df or effect-size conversion. Same-test P = 0.02 retained in test_statistic; p field unassigned. PDF p. 213 and p. 215 visually inspected. Source title matches supplied reference; printed article header gives 1992 whereas supplied reference gives 1993.
